mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 300 on the CPI index signals elevated risk of monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 1400) indicates real economic contraction, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1400 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy to support employment, which sustains consumer spending and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction activity above 1400 thousand units (HOUST > 1400) indicates strong consumer housing demand, supporting economic growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1400 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.0%) indicates a tight labor market, increasing consumer spending capacity and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 300 and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 680,000 million dollars), sustained economic expansion supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 680000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
